sources.title: Bimal Bandyopadhyay, Excavations at Udayagiri-2 (1997–2000), Memoirs of ASI100, 2007
sources.locator: Printed p.4/PDF p.22, The Site and Its Environs; title PDF p.5; chapter opening PDF p.19

claims: Regional hill ranges identified as Alti/Nalti, Assia and Mahavinayaka.

sources.title: Gouri Kumar Brahma, Jagannath: The Symbol of Peaceful Co-existence
sources.edition: Odisha Review May–June2015, pp58–63; explicit reprint from Orissa Review July1969
sources.locator: Claim printed p.62/PDF p.66; title/author printed p.58/PDF p.62; reprint note printed p.63/PDF p.67
sources.access: Original government-hosted PDF downloaded. Normal TLS failed expired certificate; narrow curl --insecure public-PDF retrieval used without persistent security changes. Claim matched indexed original. Title, claim and reprint pages rendered and visually read.
claims: One Mahavinayaka monolith is associated with Shiva, Durga, Vishnu, Ganesh and Surya; portions assigned to each deity.
Author interprets shared worship as religious accommodation.
limits: Historic Cuttack district and railway nomenclature are not current geographic guidance.

sources.title: R. K. Periwal (compiler), Siva Temples of South India
sources.locator: Printed p.5/PDF p.21, Chandi Temple and Mahavinayak Siva Temple; Chandikhol heading printed p.4/PDF p.20; imprint PDF p.2
sources.access: Original scanned edition downloaded from Rare Book Society of India. Cover, imprint, preface and relevant printed pp4–5 visually inspected. Image-only book; no whole-book reading claim.
claims: Mahavinayak at Chandikhol distinguished from nearby Chandi temple.
Natural linga represents Ganapati, Rudra, Narayan, Surya and Sakti Devi.
Guide records hill-fed stream beside Mahavinayak.
limits: Dated devotional compilation, not recent inspection.
Do not adopt old road distances, accommodation, hours, general seasonal rules or perennial-flow assurance as current visitor facts.
